description: Open Bridge to Earn tasks on the Wanchain task board, read from OrbitWan's own node, newest first (sort ending_soonest orders by deadline). Optional after_id (1 to 12 digits) returns only tasks with a higher id: poll again with after_id set to the returned next_after_id to get only newer open tasks. Each amount has an exact decimal string beside its raw base-unit integer (null means not proven, not zero); ends_in gives the seconds left by the node's own clock and an hours-minutes text; urls give the claim page, the creating transaction and each token's OrbitWan page. Task names are never served. prepare_bridge_to_earn drives each task step by step: call it, do what its next says, and call again until done.
name: list_bridge_to_earn_tasks
title: Open Bridge to Earn tasks
